purpose: Show where in the network the edits sit: every changed weight lives in the decoder token-embedding matrix, which is tied to the output projection, so the figure must make clear that no encoder or attention weights were touched.
filter: rows for fp17 (registered); fp10 may be shown as a lighter companion
encodings: a schematic bar chart of whisper-tiny's parameter groups along the x axis in network order (encoder conv stem, encoder blocks 0-3, decoder embed_tokens / proj_out (tied), decoder blocks 0-3, layer norms), with bar height = number of changed weights (log scale or broken axis so zeros are visible as empty bars labelled '0'); only the tied embedding/projection bar is non-zero: 165,888 weights in 432 token rows for fp17; a text box explaining the tie (one edited row changes both the token's input embedding and its output logit) and listing the two edit groups (426 digit-token rows × 0.65; 'cause', 'gonna', 'gotta' rows × 1.10, from Milestone2/WSP_Whisper/edits/edits_fp17.json)

axes.x: parameter group of whisper-tiny, in network order

caption: Where the registered edits sit. All 165,888 changed weights (0.44% of the model) are rows of the decoder's token-embedding matrix, which shares storage with the output projection; the encoder, attention and feed-forward weights are untouched.
